item.title: Word of the Day: Flibbertigibbet
item.description: Phonetic: /flibərdēˈjibət,ˈflibərdēˌjibət/Part of Speech: adjective Definition a frivolous, flighty, or excessively talkative person. “she’s not the extravagant flibbertigibbet she is being portrayed as” Origin: Middle English

item.title: Remember This: A brighter light
item.description: By Brad Dison Erwin Perzy built and repaired surgical instruments for local physicians in Vienna, Austria. In 1900, one of his clients requested a brighter light for his operating room. Just 23 years earlier in 1879, Thomas Edison filed a patent for his carbon-filament lamp and thus began the electric light age. item.title: Atamah, Valentine combine for 39 points as NSU delivers big win at McNeese
item.description: LAKE CHARLES — Behind standout performances from Vernell Atamah and Nya Valentine, Northwestern State secured a major 65–58 road win over McNeese on Monday night at Townsley Law Arena.
